en.headline: Travel council says Mid-Autumn visitor numbers encouraging ahead of Golden Week
en.dek: TIC chairman Tam Kwong-shun said hotels for 1 to 3 October are nearly full and more than half of National Day visitors are expected to stay overnight.
body: The Travel Industry Council chairman, Tam Kwong-shun, said mainland visitor numbers over the Mid-Autumn break were encouraging and that the trade is optimistic about spending during the National Day Golden Week.

Speaking on RTHK’s Millennium on Monday, Tam said Mid-Autumn and the mainland Golden Week fall close together this year. Mainland travellers who take three extra days of leave from Monday to Wednesday can string together a 13-day break. He said a steadier mainland economy had lifted the appetite for outbound travel, while events such as the Tai Hang fire dragon dance and the International Lantern Spectacular at Victoria Park had drawn visitors to Hong Kong.

Many mainland travellers chose to come earlier, during Mid-Autumn, to avoid the peak, Tam said, and some would continue to other Greater Bay Area cities. For 1 to 7 October he expected a large share of day trips, with overnight visitors making up a little more than half. Tour-group guests typically stay two to three nights.

Even after double-digit hotel rate increases this year, rooms from 1 to 3 October were close to fully booked, which he described as satisfactory. He expected restaurants and retailers of cosmetics and electronics to benefit and said recent licence revocations over forced shopping showed the regulator was taking enforcement seriously, which he argued would strengthen visitor confidence.

zh.headline: 旅議會：中秋訪港內地客令人鼓舞 國慶酒店近滿
zh.dek: 主席譚光舜表示，10月1至3日酒店已接近預訂爆滿，估計黃金周過夜旅客佔五成多。
body: 旅遊業議會主席譚光舜表示，中秋期間內地訪港旅客人數令人鼓舞，業界對國慶黃金周消費氛圍感樂觀。
譚光舜周一在港台節目《千禧年代》指出，今年中秋與內地國慶黃金周相距較短，內地旅客若由即日起至周三額外請假三天，可享一連13天假期。他說近期內地經濟持續回穩，外遊消費意欲上升，加上大坑舞火龍及維園「國際中秋綵燈匯」等盛事，吸引旅客來港。
他指不少內地旅客選擇錯峰，提早在中秋來港，部分其後會轉往大灣區其他城市。估計10月1至7日亦有不少即日來回旅客，過夜客約佔五成多，旅行團旅客一般逗留兩至三晚。
即使今年酒店房價錄得雙位數升幅，10月1至3日已接近預訂爆滿，他形容情況理想。他又預料餐飲以及化妝品和電子產品等零售業將受惠，並指近期有旅行代理商及導遊因強迫購物被撤銷牌照，反映監管機構執法嚴厲，有助加強旅客信心。
